build_notebook_from_mdx: build a Jupyter notebook from an MDX file with a given title and output directory
extract_code_cells: extract Python code and output cells from MDX content using fenced code block markers
split_frameworks: read an MDX file and split content into separate PyTorch and TensorFlow versions
convert_to_notebook_cell: convert a code string or code-output tuple into a proper nbformat notebook cell
create_notebooks_for_language: create notebooks for all sections of a given language from the course toctree
